annotation.title_clean: L'Europe, pionnière en matière de législation sur l'intelligence artificielle : la loi sur l'IA entre en vigueur aujourd'hui
annotation.title_en: Europe, pioneer in artificial intelligence legislation: the AI Act enters into force today
annotation.venue: European Commission Representation in Belgium website
annotation.summary_en: European Commission news item announcing the EU AI Act's entry into force on 1 August 2024. It explains the four-tier risk-based approach, general-purpose AI rules, the AI Office and implementation timeline, the AI Pact and forthcoming guidelines and codes of practice. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Act classifies AI systems into minimal, transparency, high and unacceptable risk tiers
Unacceptable-risk practices such as social scoring are banned after six months
General-purpose AI rules apply after 12 months; most rules apply from 2 August 2026
Member states must designate national authorities by 2 August 2025; AI Office oversees enforcement
AI Pact encourages voluntary early compliance; codes of practice are being prepared
